translations.EN: That's close enough. What do you want?
translations.TL: Hanggang diyan ka lang. Ano ang gusto mo?

translations.EN: Hands where I can see them. Who are you?
translations.TL: Kamay kung saan ko nakikita. Sino ka?

translations.EN: Stop right there. State your business.
translations.TL: Tigil diyan. Sabihin mo ang pakay mo.

translations.EN: Keep your distance. What brings you over here?
translations.TL: Panatilihin ang distansya. Anong nagdala sa 'yo rito?

translations.EN: Don't take another step. Who sent you?
translations.TL: Huwag ka nang humakbang pa. Sinong nagpadala sa 'yo?

translations.EN: Hold it. Are you armed?
translations.TL: Sandali. May armas ka ba?

translations.EN: Stay where you are. Why are you approaching me?
translations.TL: Diyan ka lang. Bakit ka lumalapit sa akin?

translations.EN: Hold ground. What are you after?
translations.TL: Diyan ka lang. Anong hinahabol mo?

translations.EN: Keep your hands clear of your waist. Who are you?
translations.TL: Ilayo ang kamay sa baywang. Sino ka?

translations.EN: One wrong twitch and we have a problem. Speak up.
translations.TL: Isang maling galaw at magkakaproblema tayo. Magsalita ka.

translations.EN: Hold it. Who are you?
translations.TL: Sandali. Sino ka?

translations.EN: Hold up a second. What's your name?
translations.TL: Teka sandali. Anong pangalan mo?

translations.EN: Who goes there? Speak up.
translations.TL: Sino 'yan? Magsalita ka.

translations.EN: Stop there for a moment. Are you friendly?
translations.TL: Tigil muna diyan. Kaibigan ka ba?

translations.EN: Hold on. What brings you to this area?
translations.TL: Teka muna. Anong ginagawa mo sa lugar na 'to?

translations.EN: State who you are and what you're doing here.
translations.TL: Sabihin kung sino ka at anong ginagawa mo rito.

translations.EN: Hold it right there. Let's talk before you come closer.
translations.TL: Diyan ka muna. Mag-usap tayo bago ka lumapit pa.

translations.EN: Who are you and who are you with?
translations.TL: Sino ka at sinong kasama mo?

translations.EN: Stop there. Just want to make sure you're not a threat.
translations.TL: Tigil diyan. Nais ko lang tiyakin na di ka banta.

translations.EN: Hold up. Give me a name and a reason you're here.
translations.TL: Teka lang. Bigyan mo ako ng pangalan at dahilan kung bakit ka narito.

translations.EN: Who are you?
translations.TL: Sino ka?

translations.EN: Halt.
translations.TL: Hinto.

translations.EN: Identify.
translations.TL: Magpakilala.

translations.EN: Stop.
translations.TL: Tigil.

translations.EN: Name?
translations.TL: Pangalan?

translations.EN: Hands up.
translations.TL: Itaas ang kamay.

translations.EN: Purpose?
translations.TL: Pakay?

translations.EN: Freeze.
translations.TL: Huwag gagalaw.

translations.EN: State business.
translations.TL: Sabihin ang sadya.

translations.EN: Who's there?
translations.TL: Sino 'yan?

translations.EN: Easy. I don't know you yet.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan. Hindi pa kita kilala.

translations.EN: Hold on there, stranger. Let's introduce ourselves first.
translations.TL: Teka muna, estranghero. Magpakilala muna tayo.

translations.EN: Easy does it. Are you alone out here?
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Nag-iisa ka ba rito?

translations.EN: Hey there. Don't be frightened, just tell me your name.
translations.TL: Kumusta. Huwag kang matakot, sabihin mo lang pangalan mo.

translations.EN: Slow down, friend. Let's see who we're talking to.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang, kaibigan. Tingnan natin kung sino ang kausap.

translations.EN: Peace. Just hold up so we can get acquainted.
translations.TL: Kapayapaan. Huminto ka muna para magkakilala tayo.

translations.EN: Hello. I don't recognize your face—who might you be?
translations.TL: Kumusta. Di ko pamilyar ang mukha mo—sino ka?

translations.EN: Easy now. Just looking out for safety. Who are you?
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Nag-iingat lang. Sino ka?

translations.EN: Stay there a second, stranger. Where are you heading?
translations.TL: Diyan ka muna sandali, estranghero. Saan ang punta mo?

translations.EN: Welcome, but take it slow. What's your story?
translations.TL: Maligayang pagdating, pero dahan-dahan lang. Ano ang kuwento mo?
